triggerCases.prompt: Review this migration guide and inline code comments for accuracy and unnecessary generated prose.
Review this internal data transformation for correctness and test coverage.
Review this pull request across documentation accuracy, localization, and test quality.

outputCases.prompt: Perform a read-only documentation review of this setup guide and comment.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only documentation review that identifies incorrect instructions and redundant commentary by their reader impact, not presumed authorship.
assertions: The review checks the documented command against the supplied implementation.
It recommends removing or rewriting the redundant comment only with a concrete reader benefit.
It does not describe text as AI-generated.

outputCases.prompt: Review this documentation and return the findings in chat only. Do not create a review artifact or post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only documentation review returned in chat without a local artifact or GitHub write.
assertions: The workflow returns the documentation findings directly in chat.
The workflow does not create or open a local review document.
The workflow does not modify source or post to GitHub.
